# Libraries

Copied unchanged from npm, so Model Studio runs without a build step or a CDN.

| Folder | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three/` | [three](https://www.npmjs.com/package/three) — `build/three.module.min.js` and the `examples/jsm` files Model Studio imports | 0.170.0 | MIT (`three/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `occt/` | [occt-import-js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/occt-import-js) — OpenCascade compiled to WebAssembly; reads STEP, IGES and BREP | 0.0.23 | LGPL-2.1 (`occt/license.occt-import-js.txt`, `occt/license.occt.txt`) |
